newsitem.title: FINLAND: Extra EU summit in Maastricht on May 23 -agency.
newsitem.headline: Extra EU summit in Maastricht on May 23 -agency.

text.p: EU member countries will hold an extraordinary summit meeting on May 23 in Maastricht, the Netherlands, to give an extra push to efforts to seal a new treaty for the union, Finnish news agency STT said on Friday.
Quoting a Finnish EU source in Brussels, the agency said current European Union president the Netherlands was expected to announce the summit date later on Friday.

The Dutch EU presidency said on Wednesday it was considering an extra summit of European Union heads of government to try and kick-start deadlocked talks on reforming the bloc's unwieldy institutions.
The news agency said the Dutch planned a one-day meeting with heads of state and government and foreign ministers.
It said the agenda would include so-called institutional issues, the size of the EU Commission after enlargement, votes in the Council of Ministers, and the move to more majority decisions.

It cited Finnish sources as saying the agenda would also include a common EU foreign and security policy and talks would cover the relationship between the European Union and the its defence arm, the Western European Union.
